ChangePasswordRequest.description:
The body for changing your own password (Story 2.6).

The length of the new password is checked in the service, by the password
policy. That way the client gets the same `password_too_short` error as when an
admin resets a password.
ChangePasswordRequest.title: ChangePasswordRequest

DraftSource.description: An imperial value found in the source. The code converts it to metric (FR-21).
DraftSource.title: DraftSource

ErrorCode.description:
Error codes that do not change. The client shows the message
`errors.<code>` from he.json.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

ErrorEvent.description: `event: error`. An error after the stream started. `code` is an AD-28 code.
ErrorEvent.title: ErrorEvent

IngredientCreate.description: An ingredient sent when saving a recipe. Its order is its place in the list.
IngredientCreate.title: IngredientCreate

IngredientUpdate.description:
An ingredient sent when updating a recipe. If it has an `id`, it is an
existing ingredient (AD-20).
IngredientUpdate.title: IngredientUpdate

LoginRequest.description:
Login details. The email is a plain string on purpose: an invalid email is
treated like any wrong email and password.
LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest

OriginalValue.description:
The ingredient's amount and unit before its first edit (FR-7).

If both fields are null, it was "to taste" before the edit.
OriginalValue.title: OriginalValue

PhotoFromUrl.description:
A photo to download from a link, for example of an imported recipe
(AD-23, AD-27).
PhotoFromUrl.title: PhotoFromUrl

PhotoLimits.description: The upload limits, shown by the form next to the photo field.
PhotoLimits.title: PhotoLimits

PhotoRead.description:
A photo as it appears inside API responses (AD-27). The server builds the
URLs.
PhotoRead.title: PhotoRead

PhotoUploaded.description: An uploaded photo that no recipe uses yet. Saving a recipe attaches it.
PhotoUploaded.title: PhotoUploaded

RecipeCreate.description: All the data needed to create a recipe.
RecipeCreate.title: RecipeCreate

RecipeUpdate.description:
The full recipe, which replaces the saved one (AD-4). It never includes the
original values.
RecipeUpdate.title: RecipeUpdate

Role.description:
The user roles. A visitor is simply not logged in, so there is no visitor
role (AD-30).
Role.title: Role

SessionResponse.description: The current session. `user` is null for a visitor.
SessionResponse.title: SessionResponse

SessionUser.description: The details of the logged-in user that the client may see (AD-21).
SessionUser.title: SessionUser

SourceUnit.description:
Imperial units that an import converted to metric. We keep the original unit
as the 'source' value.
SourceUnit.title: SourceUnit

SourceValue.description: The imperial value that an import converted to metric (FR-21).
SourceValue.title: SourceValue

StageEvent.description: `event: stage`. Reports a real step of the import. There is no percentage.
StageEvent.title: StageEvent

TagCreate.description: The body of `POST /tags`. The name is cleaned up and its length is checked.
TagCreate.title: TagCreate

TagInput.description:
A tag sent when saving a recipe: either the id of an existing tag, or a name.
A name is matched to an existing tag, or a new tag is created.
TagInput.title: TagInput

TagRef.description: A tag as it appears inside a recipe in API responses (AD-20).
TagRef.title: TagRef

TagUpdate.description: The body of `PATCH /tags/{id}`. Send only the fields that change.
TagUpdate.title: TagUpdate

UserCreateRequest.description:
The body of `POST /api/users`: the new account and its first password.

The form's "confirm password" field is checked only in the browser. The server
only checks the password policy (FR-13).
UserCreateRequest.title: UserCreateRequest

UserRead.description: A user as the API returns it. On purpose, it has no password field.
UserRead.title: UserRead

UserUpdate.description:
The body of `PATCH /api/users/{id}`. Send at least one field.

A field that is not sent does not change. Sending `password` resets it: the new
password replaces the old one and the user is logged out on all devices.
UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate

post.description: Logs out by deleting the cookie. Always succeeds, even if not logged in.

Changes the logged-in user's own password (FR-27). Editors and admins can
both use it.

Changing the password makes the old cookie invalid, so the response sets a new
cookie. This device stays logged in, and all other devices are logged out.

get.description: Returns the logged-in user, or `user: null` for a visitor. Always 200 (AD-21).

post.description: Turns pasted recipe text into a Hebrew draft, and streams the progress.

200.description: A `text/event-stream` (AD-40): `stage` events `{name, status}`, then one `draft` event (a DraftRecipe) or one `error` event `{code, detail, params}`.

post.description:
Downloads a recipe page, turns it into a Hebrew draft, and streams the
progress.

200.description: A `text/event-stream` (AD-40): `stage` events `{name, status}`, then one `draft` event (a DraftRecipe) or one `error` event `{code, detail, params}`.

post.description:
Downloads a photo from a link (for example, of an imported recipe) and saves
it. No recipe uses it yet.
